tools.name: extract
tools.description: Return fields from one public page. Call extractors.list for hosts, paths, and the sample schema. You can ask for title, heading, or both. If the page has no extractor, the error points to extractors.list. Call keys.create once. Pass caller_key on every later tools/call.

tools.name: extract_batch
tools.description: Run up to 20 extract calls. Each item has its own status. Call extractors.list for the sample schema. Call keys.create once. Pass caller_key on every later tools/call.

tools.name: explain_extractor
tools.description: Show selectors, version, and hit count. This does not fetch the page.

tools.name: extractors.list
tools.description: List active pages, fields, and a sample schema. This does not fetch a page. No caller key is required.

tools.name: keys.create
tools.description: Mint a pf_ caller key. The raw key is shown once. Pass this key on every later tools/call. Send it as the caller_key argument.

remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.

remediation.title: Tool description changed since last scan
remediation.detail: Tool "extract_batch" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
